entities.name: Sant'Antonio di Padova a Circonvallazione Appia
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Sant'Antonio di Padova a Circonvallazione Appia is a church in Rome, built in 1938 in the Rationalist style. It was made a cardinalate deaconry on 18 February 2012 by Pope Benedict XVI. The recent assigned cardinal is George Jacob Koovakad.
